eslint/rules/block-component-in-paragrap.name: Block component in paragraph
eslint/rules/block-component-in-paragrap.description: Rejects a Callout, Tabs or Cards inside a paragraph whose other content stops Fumadocs from removing the paragraph wrapper.

eslint/rules/callout-type.ts.name: Callout type check
eslint/rules/callout-type.ts.description: Rejects a <Callout type> outside info, warn, error, idea and success.

eslint/rules/component-in-heading.ts.name: Component in heading
eslint/rules/component-in-heading.ts.description: Rejects a JSX component such as <Var> or <Term> inside a heading.

eslint/rules/docusaurus-directive.ts.name: Docusaurus admonition
eslint/rules/docusaurus-directive.ts.description: Rejects a :::note style directive line, which nothing converts so readers see the colons.

eslint/rules/docusaurus-var-token.ts.name: Docusaurus var token
eslint/rules/docusaurus-var-token.ts.description: Rejects a Docusaurus @@name@@ or @@name=value@@ variable token.

eslint/rules/esm-in-page.ts.name: ESM in page
eslint/rules/esm-in-page.ts.description: Rejects a top-level import or export statement in a content file.

eslint/rules/frontmatter-schema.ts.name: Frontmatter schema check
eslint/rules/frontmatter-schema.ts.description: Rejects a content/docs page whose frontmatter fails arbitrumPageSchema: missing title or description, or an out-of-enum content_type.

eslint/rules/link-in-heading.ts.name: Link in heading
eslint/rules/link-in-heading.ts.description: Rejects a markdown link or bare URL inside a heading.

eslint/rules/markdown-in-title.ts.name: Markdown in title
eslint/rules/markdown-in-title.ts.description: Rejects bold, italic, backticks or a link in the title attribute of a <Callout> or <Accordion>.

eslint/rules/quicklook-anchor.ts.name: Quicklook anchor
eslint/rules/quicklook-anchor.ts.description: Rejects a Docusaurus <a data-quicklook-from> glossary anchor.

eslint/rules/remote-image.ts.name: Remote image
eslint/rules/remote-image.ts.description: Rejects a markdown image whose src is an http(s) URL.

eslint/rules/unknown-component.ts.name: Unknown component
eslint/rules/unknown-component.ts.description: Rejects a capitalised JSX tag that components/mdx.tsx does not register and Fumadocs does not provide by default.

eslint/rules/unknown-term.ts.name: Unknown term
eslint/rules/unknown-term.ts.description: Rejects a <Term id> or <Reference collection id> whose id has no entry in the collection, or whose collection is not registered.

eslint/rules/unknown-var.ts.name: Unknown variable
eslint/rules/unknown-var.ts.description: Rejects a <Var name> or {var:name} whose name is not a key in content/vars.json.

eslint/rules/var-in-code.ts.name: Var in code
eslint/rules/var-in-code.ts.description: Rejects a <Var> inside a fenced block or inline code span.

eslint/rules/var-in-link.ts.name: Var in link
eslint/rules/var-in-link.ts.description: Rejects a <Var> in a link destination or href, to or src attribute, and a {var:…} placeholder whose name is not an identifier.
